Initial release of ClawTeam skill.

- Enables team assembly by matching people based on skills, roles, and work styles.
- Triggers on phrases like "find a team", "build a team", "I need a cofounder", and "ClawTeam".
- Focuses on assembling teams for startups, side projects, or collaborative work.
- User data remains local and private.
